title: Rao 1958 optimum-thrust Nozzle B
description: Strict axisymmetric inviscid benchmark of the current Rao BVP against Rao 1958 Tables 2 and 3. Table-2 coordinates are rounded to 0.01 Rt; the contour RMS tolerance accounts for that printed precision and finite BVP grid resolution.

source.citation: Rao, G. V. R., Exhaust Nozzle Contour for Optimum Thrust, Jet Propulsion 28(6), 1958, pp. 377-382, DOI 10.2514/8.7324.
references: Table 2: Optimum thrust nozzle B coordinates, Mach number, and wall slope
Figure 1 and equations 1-2: complete C-D-E control-surface momentum integral
source.notes: The strict thrust metric uses the directly reconstructed full C-D-E surface, never ideal-Cf mass scaling.

curves.axis_calibration: Printed x/Rt and y/Rt values; both rounded to 0.01

expected_physics_gaps: The solve remains an inviscid constant-gamma benchmark; it is not a viscous performance or hardware validation.
The current nonlinear residual may remain above the reliability-promotion tolerance even when the published contour and full-surface thrust checks pass.
Table-2 values are sparse and rounded, so this case validates the published integral/shape envelope rather than pointwise CFD flowfield detail.
